what_happened: The job gave agents read-only, filtered access to commits a job names. The verifier rejected it at the final verdict. One of 8 acceptance criteria was unmet: docs/decisions.md D08 (or a new decision) must record the change with alternatives and tradeoffs, and must no longer say agents never see real history. There was one major finding and no blocker. D08 (docs/decisions.md:233) still says agents lose the real history. It was neither reworded nor marked as amended. No checks are listed as failed, and the code change is not reported as wrong. Only the decision record was left contradicting the new behavior.
cause: The decision log is prose, and nothing links a decision to the code or behavior it governs. The producer has no step that searches the decisions for statements the change reverses. The reading did list a docs criterion, but it gave the producer a loose "D08 or a new decision" choice and did not name the exact sentence to reword. Athena's checks run on the final tree and do not test docs for contradictions, so the stale sentence stays until the verifier reads the docs. Reversing a past decision is a recurring kind of change, so this will happen again.
prevention: Add a check that runs before verification. Every decision in docs/decisions.md that a change reverses must either be marked "amended by" or "superseded by" a later decision, or be reworded. The check works from a small machine-readable list that ties each decision to the claim it makes, such as "agents never see real history". When a job's reading says it reverses a decision, the check requires that decision's entry to appear in the diff. It also scans the diff's docs for known phrases from the old claim. At reading time, the reading must name the exact decision and the sentence to change, instead of the choice "D08 or a new decision".
proposed_request: Fix docs/decisions.md so it matches the history access that agents now have. Decision D08 (around line 233) still says agents never see real history, which is no longer true now that agents get read-only, filtered access to the commits a job names. Amend D08 to say what changed: agents can read the named commits through a filtered, read-only view, and the rest of the history stays hidden. Mark it "amended by" a new decision, and add that decision with the alternatives considered (no history access, full history access, generated file only) and the tradeoffs of each. Then read through docs/decisions.md and the other docs for any other sentence that says agents never see real history, and reword or mark it. Only docs files may change. Done means no remaining sentence in the docs says agents never see real history, D08 points to the new decision, and the new decision lists alternatives and tradeoffs.
